name: PoolFlow: Pool Service Pro
subtitle: Routes, Logs & Water Testing
promotionalText: Built for solo Australian pool techs: offline routes, service logs, LSI dosing and per-pool profit—without fleet-software overhead. Free for 5 pools.
description:
PoolFlow is the all-in-one iPhone and iPad app for independent pool service professionals in Australia. Replace paper logs, manual LSI calculations and scattered spreadsheets with one field tool that works offline — because pool software needs to work poolside.

PLAN ROUTES
View your daily route by weekday, drag to reorder stops, open Apple Maps directions and track each stop as it is completed. PoolFlow Pro includes route optimisation for a more efficient run.

LOG WATER TESTING
Record water test readings, service notes, chemical doses and proof-of-service photos in one visit record. See the Langelier Saturation Index (LSI) at a glance and use clear dosing guidance when water needs attention.

KEEP THE BUSINESS IN VIEW
Track chemical inventory, equipment, service history and pool-level profitability. Record monthly service fees in A$ and see chemical spend alongside revenue to understand which accounts are working for the business.

BUILT FOR AU FIELD WORK
- Metric-friendly workflow, including litres for pool volume
- Australian spelling and A$ examples in the local demo data
- Large controls designed for poolside work
- Works offline when reception is patchy

START FREE
Manage up to 5 pools for free. PoolFlow Pro unlocks unlimited pools, route optimisation, profit analytics, full backup and iCloud sync. Paid terms and any free-trial offer are shown in A$ in the App Store before purchase.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel subscriptions in your Account Settings.
